svg.title: Driver Dreamer — Brush Drive — Red Header
svg.desc: A Brush Drive typography study retains the selected White Emotion website composition, untinted Ferrari photograph and direct transparent logos. White Futura CHASE THE is paired with red lowercase feeling in genuine Brush Script MT italic. Its lifted baseline keeps the full handwritten descender inside the open sky, above the car. The collection heading repeats the same red brush lettering while navigation, body copy and small interface labels retain Futura. One white editorial section and the red legal footer remain unchanged.

g.text: FOR THE CARS THAT STAY WITH YOU

text.tspan: Make a place for your next dream.

g.text: RED EXTERIOR / TAN INTERIOR / SILVER WHEELS

text.tspan: Turn a passing obsession into a personal collection.

See which one speaks to you.
